questions.stem: Which indication for rigid oesophagoscopy involves removing a swallowed object?
What is the main reason for airway protection in rigid oesophagoscopy?
Which airway device is mandatory for rigid oesophagoscopy?
Why must rigid oesophagoscopy be done under full muscle relaxation?
questions.answer: Movement or bucking greatly increases the risk of oesophageal perforation

questions.stem: Which short-acting opioid is used to blunt the sympathetic response in rigid oesophagoscopy?
Which signs after rigid oesophagoscopy should raise suspicion of oesophageal perforation?
questions.answer: Surgical emphysema, chest pain, unexplained tachycardia
